plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/23754
Abbott disclosed two separate incidents in July 2026; this record covers the Cancer Diagnostics intrusion claimed by ShinyHunters. The second, the externally hosted LabCentral customer portal accessed on July 4, 2026 with compromised customer credentials (claimed by ShadowByt3$; Abbott found no sensitive data exposed), is a separate incident and is not coded here; reviewer may add it as its own record.
Hacking Unknown with social Extortion (leak deadline). Data claimed but not confirmed by Abbott -> data_disclosure Potentially. NAICS 3254 -> 325413 (in-vitro diagnostics). Employee count Over 100000.

summary: Abbott Laboratories said on July 16, 2026 that there had been unauthorized access to a limited number of internal systems in its Cancer Diagnostics business. ShinyHunters claimed the attack, saying it stole internal documents, contracts, customer information, over 22 million doctor-patient notes, over 20 million medical orders and more than a million US Social Security numbers, and set a July 21 deadline before leaking. Abbott said operations and patient care were not affected; the data claims were unverified.
